Google Unveils Gemini 4 Argon AI Model for Developers and Businesses

Google has launched its new flagship artificial intelligence model, Gemini 4 Argon. The AI model is designed for developers and businesses, with a stated focus on complex coding, cybersecurity, scientific research, robotics, and enterprise AI applications. Google described Gemini 4 Argon as a 'powerhouse' AI model.
